robotcompR

robotcompR is an R-native framework for robotics computation: spatial mathematics on SO(2), SO(3), SE(2) and SE(3), rigid-body tree robot models, Denavit-Hartenberg models, forward and inverse kinematics, and Jacobians. It needs no MATLAB, Python, Julia or ROS 2.

Development is in progress; see NEWS.md for the current feature set.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/robotcompR")

License

GPL-3. robotcompR is research and teaching software. It is not certified for controlling industrial, medical, automotive or other safety-critical hardware.
